_comment: Programs that belong on /retreats but are not posted on Retreat Guru, so
tools/gen_retreats.py cannot pull them. They render through exactly the
same template as the Retreat Guru ones and get the same /retreats/<slug>
URL — the point being that every retreat on the site has a link of its own,
whoever happens to be taking the registrations.
Fields mirror Retreat Guru's own program JSON so the template needs no
special case. There is no `ID`: that is what marks an entry as ours, and it
is what tells the page not to try to refresh itself from the RG feed.
The extra `_cta*` fields exist because the call to action is not always
'apply on Retreat Guru' — the Nepal pilgrimage registers with the Karuna
Keep the copy here in step with the hand-built section on Retreats.dc.html;
both describe the same program to the same reader.

programs.title: Himalayan Pilgrimage: An Indigenous Wisdom Journey Through Nepal
programs.location: Kathmandu and the Langtang Himal, Nepal
programs.teacher_list: In collaboration with the Karuna Project
programs.prices: See the Karuna Project for pricing
programs._photo_alt: Himalayan Pilgrimage through Nepal with the Karuna Project
programs.excerpt: A 15-day pilgrimage through the sacred landscapes of Nepal, weaving Himalayan trekking, Tibetan Buddhist philosophy and the indigenous wisdom traditions of the Amazon and Andes into one living path of inner transformation.
programs.text_full:
Join us for a unique collaboration between Paititi Institute and the Karuna Project on a 15-day pilgrimage through the sacred landscapes of Nepal.

This immersive journey weaves together Himalayan trekking, Tibetan Buddhist philosophy, and the indigenous wisdom traditions of the Amazon and Andes. Through Primordial Breathwork, Qigong, dreamwork, meditation, and meaningful cultural exchange, participants will experience Nepal not only as a destination, but as a living path of inner transformation.

From the sacred temples of Kathmandu to the breathtaking Langtang Himal, this pilgrimage combines contemplative practice, ethical adventure, and service to local communities, creating an experience that nourishes body, mind, and spirit.

We are honored to partner with the Karuna Project in offering this extraordinary journey.
programs._cta_note: The Karuna Project, our partner on this pilgrimage, holds the full itinerary, pricing and registration.
